SETUP

Both keys are free and optional. Without them the screen runs on simulated prices.

Finnhub key (live quotes, profile, peers, news, earnings): finnhub.io/register Twelve Data key (real candlestick charts): twelvedata.com/register Focus list (refreshes fastest, shown first with a star, includes your portfolio and alerts) Watchlist
Backup: saves your keys, watchlists, focus list, portfolio, alerts, notes and business panels to a file. The file contains your API keys, so keep it private.
